status_note: Eight starting points for contributors. No task is assigned or marked complete.

tasks.description: Found a broken button, a layout problem or a bug? Make one small fix and send it for review.
steps: Open the GitHub repository and make a copy using Fork. Create a branch for your fix.
Follow the README to run the site on your computer. Make your change and try the affected buttons or pages.
Open a pull request. Explain what was wrong, what you changed and how you checked it. Add screenshots for a layout change.
tasks.evidence_deliverable: A pull request with the fix and a short explanation of your checks.

tasks.description: Help the next person understand how to use the map or work on the website.
steps: Choose an instruction in the Guide or README that is missing, confusing or out of date.
Try the steps yourself, then edit the text in the GitHub repository. Use the button names people see on the site.
Open a pull request explaining which instruction you improved and why.
tasks.evidence_deliverable: A pull request with clearer instructions that you have tried yourself.

tasks.description: Choose a place that is missing a date, an address, a description or a source.
steps: Open Places and choose an entry with a missing detail.
Look for that detail in a reliable source, such as a library collection, a city directory or a newspaper archive. Keep the link or full citation.
Choose Edit on the place card. Add only what you could verify, include the source, describe your change and publish it under your public username.
tasks.evidence_deliverable: An updated place with the missing detail and the source that supports it.

tasks.description: Improve a place with an unclear description, a broken source link or a detail that needs checking.
steps: Open a place and identify one thing to fix or explain more clearly.
Find a source that supports the correction. Keep a reported story separate from what the source establishes.
Choose Edit, revise the relevant fields or sources, explain the correction and publish it under your public username.
tasks.evidence_deliverable: A clearer or more accurate entry, with a source and a description of the change.

tasks.bounded_task: Add a place to the map
tasks.description: Add a New York City location connected to a reported haunting or another story from the city’s past.
steps: Find a source that names the place and describes what was reported there. Note its address or coordinates.
Search Places to make sure the location is not already on the map.
Choose Contribute, then Edit. Find or pin the location, add a title, description and source, then enter your public username and describe the change. Read the preview and publish.
tasks.evidence_deliverable: A new place inside the five boroughs, with a description and a source.

tasks.bounded_task: Add a lost building or closed business
tasks.description: Put a place from an old photograph, directory or newspaper back on the map.
steps: Choose a named building or business in a historical source. Find its street address and the date of the source.
Check what you can establish about its history: for example, when it operated, moved, closed or was demolished. A missing web listing alone does not show that a business closed.
Search Places first. If it is new, use Contribute → Edit to add it with sources and the dates you could verify. Say when a date or part of the story remains unknown.
tasks.evidence_deliverable: A sourced entry showing where the place was and what you could establish about its history.

tasks.bounded_task: Find a dataset we could map
tasks.description: Look for a public collection of New York City places that could add something to this project.
steps: Search an open-data portal, library or archive for buildings, businesses, historical sites or reported hauntings.
Check whether the records include addresses or coordinates, where the information came from and what the sharing terms allow. Look at a few sample records.
Share the dataset link in a GitHub issue. Describe what could be mapped, include three example places and note any missing locations or unclear sharing terms.
tasks.evidence_deliverable: A dataset suggestion with a source link, three example places and a note about the sharing terms.

tasks.bounded_task: Plot a few places from a dataset
tasks.description: Try a small sample before proposing a larger collection.
steps: Choose three records from a dataset whose information can be shared. Keep the original record links or citations.
Check each address or coordinate and look for the place in Places so you do not create a duplicate.
Add each new place through Contribute → Edit, including its source. Use Edit on an existing place if the dataset fills a gap or corrects a detail.
tasks.evidence_deliverable: Up to three new or improved map entries, each linked to its source record.
